tagline: Software engineer specializing in full-stack MERN development, deterministic systems, and database design.
bio: I am a software engineer with a rigorous foundation in data structures, object-oriented design, and database systems, holding a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science with a 3.7/4.0 CGPA. My core expertise is in full-stack MERN development across React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, with hands-on experience architecting deterministic recommendation engines, role-based access-control systems, and solutions built in Java and C/C++.

Through my software engineering internship at 10Pearls and formal full-stack development training, I have engineered production REST APIs, implemented JWT authentication, and maintained high code quality with Mocha, Chai, and SonarQube. As an IBM-certified full-stack JavaScript developer, I combine disciplined test-driven methodologies and modern developer tooling to deliver reliable, performant web applications.

timeline.title: Full Stack Development Trainee
timeline.description: I completed a NAVTTC-affiliated full-stack program following an IBM-aligned curriculum, advancing from web fundamentals to React-based applications. I built and version-controlled projects such as an expense tracker and a multi-page e-commerce platform using Git and GitHub.

timeline.title: MERN Stack Development Intern
timeline.description: I designed and implemented the data model and REST API for a full-stack Notes application using React, Node.js, Express, and MySQL with JWT authentication and CRUD features. I also wrote unit and integration tests using Mocha and Chai, addressing code quality findings identified by SonarQube.

timeline.title: Independent Study
timeline.description: I designed, built, and deployed over 10 full-stack MERN applications, applying core computer science coursework to production architectures. I exercised collaborative software workflows and iterative, test-driven development throughout every build.
